description_expanded: OverviewPRIVATE Heated Pool - 4 Bikes - GOLF CART option - 2 Minute Bike Ride - Hammock by the SeaThe Space Hammock by the Sea – Your Private Oasis Near 30A! QUICK HIGHLIGHTS: Private Heated Pool (Heat Optional) – Relax & unwind after a day at the beach 7-Minute Walk to the Beach – Enjoy the sugar-white sands of 30A 4 Spacious Bedrooms | 4 Bathrooms – Perfect for families & groups Two Master Suites – Both with king beds, en-suite baths & private balcony access Bunk Room – Featuring 2 twin-over-queen bunks, great for kids & extra guests Open-Concept Living Area – High ceilings, coastal-chic décor & abundant natural light Chef’s Kitchen – Fully stocked with high-end appliances & oversized island Outdoor Entertaining Space – Large patio, cozy seating, & dining under the stars Free Bikes Included – Cruise 30A & explore Seaside, WaterColor & more 6-Seater Golf Cart Rental Option – Experience 30A in style! Welcome to Hammock by the SeaTucked inside the exclusive Hammocks of Seagrove Beach, this home offers the perfect blend of luxury, comfort, and location. Designed for unforgettable family vacations, it features high-end finishes, stylish coastal décor, and spacious living areas for making memories together.The highlight? Your very own private, heated pool. Whether you’re sipping your morning coffee poolside, floating in the afternoon sun, or winding down after a day at the beach, this outdoor space is your private retreat.Inside, the open-concept living and dining area invites you to relax and recharge, while the gourmet kitchen makes cooking and entertaining effortless. And with two master suites (each with a king bed & balcony access), plus a bunk room the kids will love, there’s space for everyone to spread out comfortably.Step outside, and you’re just a quick walk or bike ride from the stunning Seagrove Beach shoreline, charming 30A towns, and some of the best dining, shopping, and entertainment on the coast.House Rules**No Pets!****No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival**SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (14):Downstairs Master - 1 King Bed, private bathroom with separate tub and showerUpstairs Master - 1 King Bed, private bathroom with walk-in showerUpstairs Queen Room - 1 Queen Bed, shared bathroom with tub/shower comboUpstairs Bunk - 2 Full Beds+2 Twin Beds, shared bathroom with tub/shower comboUpstairs Loft - 1 Twin Daybed with Trundle, shared bathroom with tub/shower comboPool Heat *Pool heating available for this property from October 1st through May 1st*Fee $50 per day and required for length of stay*Pool heat is not guaranteedAREA ATTRACTIONS:Discover the charm of Seagrove, a beach neighborhood that locals and guests love. Lush oak trees, magnolias, and pines have spread deep roots in Seagrove — and so have long-time visitors who keep coming back.Laid-back but luxurious, Seagrove is a place that embraces variety. From upscale boutiques to casual cafes, this beach neighborhood offers a little bit of everything — including two rare coastal dune lakes, a state park, and sugar-white sand. Pack a picnic, fishing pole, and binoculars — and witness how stunning Seagrove is in its all-natural state. Its sugar-white sand has been a peaceful retreat in South Walton for decades; here, old and new Gulf Coast style merge to create a charming beach neighborhood with everything one may need for a truly relaxing getaway.Show less
